subject: Giving season: give safely
preheader: Fake charities, three buttons for video calls, and a holiday letter in minutes.
intro: A short issue for the busy season.

sections.label: Scam of the week
sections.title: Fake charity requests
paragraphs: Giving season brings real charities and fake ones. The fake ones may call, text, or message you, often with a name close to a real charity.
bullets: Don't donate to someone who called or texted you.
Go to the charity's own website yourself and give there.
Be wary of anyone who wants payment by gift card or wire.

sections.label: Tip of the week
sections.title: Video calls: three buttons to know
paragraphs: Whichever app you use, find these three.
bullets: Mute: turns your microphone off so background noise doesn't interrupt.
Camera: turns your picture on or off.
Flip camera (on a phone): switch to the back camera to show something around you.

sections.label: AI trick of the week
sections.title: Draft the holiday letter
paragraphs: Give AI a few facts and it will write a warm first draft.
sections.prompt: Help me write a warm, light holiday letter to family under 250 words. This year: [list a few things that happened].
sections.note: Add your own touches before you send it. It should sound like you.
